result:
I've written the round 112 task: a measurement round where C checks the four remaining Medium findings in the cloud browser, and A changes only one doc line. The decision is CONTINUE. The store is untouched and clean at `6abd3f3`.

**Round 111:** C passed it with real browser checks (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true, 0 bugs), and the root gate published it as `6abd3f3`. From that evidence alone, C-R110-01 and GATE110-S4 are now done. The old task is copied to `tasks/round-111.md`.

**Why this round now:**
- No Critical, High or reproducible Medium bug is open.
- The regression round isn't due yet (last one 2026-10-21, today is 2026-10-23); the first planning on or after 2026-10-24 will be the regression round.
- The four remaining Mediums were only ever measured on the old loaded Windows machine, or never: C-R6-02 and C-R8-01 (video drift), C-R27-01 (drift with level meters running) and A-R38-REVIEW-TOUCH (a touch press might make a fader jump). Root's 2026-10-23 rule says a Medium with no reproducible failure in the cloud browser doesn't block T12. Nobody had tried to reproduce these in the cloud, so this round settles it with evidence.

**Round 112:**
- **A:** changes only the status line of doc 096. It's line 4, not line 3 as the gate review said; I checked the file and fixed every reference. Expected end state is one modified file. All other 919 tracked files are hash-frozen in `b-round-111-r112-tree-sha256.txt`, and the protected auth/purchase hashes are unchanged.
- **C:** the old Windows test scripts are gone, so C rebuilds the harness in Playwright. It only instruments the page and never writes to the store. It runs these checks at 1440×900, with 3 valid runs plus 2 replacements per layout:
  - the video-drift setups with the detail panel open/closed and a clip selected or not;
  - the first-Play start check;
  - the meters-running drift check;
  - an H.264 run as information only, if this Chromium can play it;
  - a touch check, using the Zoom slider as a positive control so a harness that can't reach the native slider counts as inconclusive, not PASS.
- **Tolerances:** unchanged (D-24/D-24a: median ≤ 0.05 s, max ≤ 0.1 s; the 30.1 ms meter oracle).
- **One new rule (mine):** a run where the video decoder drops more than 20 % of frames is invalid because of the environment. It doesn't apply when the drops coincide with the app's own playback-rate correction.

**Outcomes are fixed in advance** (task §5), so the numbers can't be rationalised afterwards:

| Result | Findings | SRW-03 / SRW-11B / SRW-13 | T12 |
|---|---|---|---|
| PASS | closed | move to `c_pass_tech_lead_manual` | does not block |
| Valid FAIL with app attribution | one bounded A bug round next | keep current status until that round passes | waits for that round |
| FAIL with no app attribution, or environment | stay open for the Tech Lead's quiet-Chrome check, with the cloud evidence | move to `c_pass_tech_lead_manual` | does not block |

**Other updates:**
- `backlog.json` is now v110; pre-edit copies are in `b-round-111/`.
- C-R6-02 and C-R8-01 now carry the status `open_tech_lead_quiet_chrome`; the app work rounds 7–9 asked for is done.
- The gate's testid-selector finding (GATE111-S1, Low) went to the deferred Low list, which now has 145 entries.
- I also updated D-29z77 in `plan.md`, `feature-status.md`, `b-round-111.md` and `b-next.json`.

**Architecture:** the library/video focus code has changed in four rounds (107, 108, 110, 111), so I added addendum (w) to `b-round-91-checkpoint-request.md`. It asks root for one bounded `frontend-architect` checkpoint on who owns that focus handling. It doesn't block round 112 or T12.

**Still open for the user:** B-R107-ENTER-ON-BODY: should Enter with nothing focused add the selected library item?

**Advisor:** available and consulted twice, before writing and before finishing. I applied all its points except one: it called A a no-op, and I kept the one-line doc fix, which it then agreed with.
